scope: Logical module boundary for generic ED delivery; contract data only.

owner_labels.careops_parent: CareOps parent repository owns ED domain, site policy, runner, presentation, and its export artifacts.
owner_labels.kairos_upstream: Kairos upstream owns reusable simulation engine crates and public engine interfaces.

modules.role: ED domain behavior and orchestration-facing model
Separate presentation layer; deferred interactive UI
Parent-owned exported run artifacts consumed by presentation
Public Kairos interfaces exposed to downstream consumers
Reusable DES, ABM, state, time, and simulation core crates

permitted_edges.label: public_api
permitted_edges.reason: ED domain code may use reusable simulation capabilities through the public interface.

permitted_edges.label: public_api
permitted_edges.reason: Site policy may configure or call simulation through the public interface.

permitted_edges.label: parent_application
permitted_edges.reason: The parent runner composes the ED domain layer.

permitted_edges.label: parent_application
permitted_edges.reason: The parent runner supplies the selected site policy/profile.

permitted_edges.label: public_api
permitted_edges.reason: The runner adapter may invoke simulation through the public interface.

permitted_edges.label: public_api
permitted_edges.reason: Presentation may consume only the public interface when live interaction is implemented.

permitted_edges.label: export_artifact
permitted_edges.reason: Presentation may consume exported run artifacts.

forbidden_edges.label: ed_policy_dependency
forbidden_edges.reason: Reusable engine crates cannot depend on parent ED domain policy.

forbidden_edges.label: site_policy_dependency
forbidden_edges.reason: Reusable engine crates cannot depend on site-specific policy or profiles.

forbidden_edges.label: application_dependency
forbidden_edges.reason: Reusable engine crates cannot depend on the parent application runner.

forbidden_edges.label: presentation_dependency
forbidden_edges.reason: Reusable engine crates cannot depend on presentation or UI code.

forbidden_edges.label: internal_core_dependency
forbidden_edges.reason: Presentation must use public interfaces or exported artifacts, not internal simulation-core crates.

e0_2_handoff.acceptance_statement: E0.2 must map these logical module IDs to actual Cargo packages or documented non-package boundaries, then inspect and test the implemented Cargo graph. E0.1 tests only this contract data and does not establish that the native graph conforms.
